name: Fangstorm
description:
About This Game

Fangstorm turns tower defense into a violent, first-person brawl set within a player-built meat grinder.

Ascend as Champion of the Gods

You fell heroically in battle. The Orc gods resurrected you as an ascended demigod.

Goblin invaders pour through from a corrupted realm, shielded from godly wrath by dark magic. Only you can reach them. Thousands will stain your blade. You are divine retribution.

Forge Defenses & Summon Minions

Imbued with godlike power, you bend the battlefield to your will. Engineer lethal kill zones, summon and customise savage minions, and herd goblin invaders into the slaughter.

Fight as a Demigod 

Smash into the front lines in violent first-person combat, unleashing brutal melee strikes and godlike abilities. Crush entire sieges in a whirlwind of blood.

You are as much a weapon as your defenses.

Divine Progression  

Choose a patron god and bear their mark into battle. Honour them through bloodshed and they reward you with growing power and boons.

Craft your arsenal through deep upgrade trees. Find powerful Artifacts - arcane relics that grant massive bonuses at a cost. Amplify your strengths or embrace dangerous trade-offs to create devastating, high-risk builds.

No two champions fight the same way.

Escalating Invasions

Survive intense, wave-based tower defense combat as goblin hordes grow stronger with every invasion. Greater numbers, harder units, mounting pressure - each wave tests your skill, your strategy, and the killing ground you've built.

Too easy? Choose from 5 difficulty levels and spend currency to apply punishing modifiers and face truly brutal assaults. Succeed and reap greater rewards, fail and lose your stake.

Fangstorm blends first-person combat with tower defense strategy, offering a unique FPS tower defense experience where you build traps, summon customisable units, defend castles, and fight in intense wave-based battles.

We think you'll love Fangstorm if you enjoy…

Orcs Must Die!, Warhammer: Vermintide 2, Killing Floor 2, Deathtrap, Dungeon Defenders II, Sanctum 2, Helldivers 2, Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity, Left 4 Dead, Chivalry II, Warhammer 40,000: Darktide.
short_desc: You are the defense. One orc demigod against relentless goblin sieges. Fight in brutal first-person melee, unleash devastating abilities, and build kill zones. Use a deep, persistent progression system to turn yourself into a meat grinder forged by endless carnage.
